# React Router Specialist Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Frontend > React

## Overview

Configures React Router for complex navigation including nested routes, data loaders, protected routes, and code splitting

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [react-router-specialist-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
react-router-specialist-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@react-router-specialist` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Configure data routers with loaders and actions
- Implement nested routes with outlet components
- Build protected route wrappers with redirect logic
- Set up code-split routes with React.lazy and Suspense

## Technology Standards Applied

- **React Router v6**: Data router patterns with loaders and actions
- **Code Splitting**: Route-based code splitting with React.lazy
- **Protected Routes**: Authentication and authorization patterns
